package install_test

import (
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/zalkilabs/zalki/internal/install"
)

// Generator, run only inside a copy of the rc.8 tree: installs with the rc.8
// installer into a temporary home that holds the user's own settings, and stores
// every file the installer left (home path written as <HOME>).
func TestGenerateRC8Fixture(t *testing.T) {
	isolateConfigEnv(t)
	home := t.TempDir()
	seedHome(t, home, goldenUserFiles)
	if _, err := install.Manage(configDeclare, goldenRequest(home, "install", goldenBinary)); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := "<output-dir>"
	_ = os.RemoveAll(out)
	for name, content := range snapshotHome(t, home) {
		path := filepath.Join(out, filepath.FromSlash(name))
		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(path), 0o755); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := os.WriteFile(path, []byte(content), 0o644); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
}
